alt: Back view of a white Google Pixel smartphone showing the camera module and Google logo, the location of the Quick Tap gesture sensor that stops working when a phone case is applied
story: Google's 'Quick Tap' feature lets Pixel owners double-tap the back of their phone to trigger shortcuts, but a July 7, 2026 Pocket-lint investigation found the sensor cannot reliably detect taps through even a thin silicone case — meaning the feature is functionally useless for the overwhelming majority of users who protect their phones.
why_funny: Google engineered a time-saving shortcut for the imaginary Pixel owner who keeps their $1,000 phone naked, leaving everyone else to tap their way to absolutely nothing.
